name: python-quickjs-ng
notice_policy: Retain binding LICENSE and leading copyright/license comments from every engine C/H source. Package quickjs-notices.txt and quickjs-provenance.json; audit their hashes and extension origin.
build_boundary: Network only in explicit CI dependency preparation. Linux uses the pinned official CPython ABI3 wheel; Windows UCRT64 builds the pinned sdist. build_flatpak.py only copies prepared local runtime files and performs no QuickJS download. No claim of reproducible wheel-to-source equivalence.
